category: The system of record for AI agents
headline: Delegate more than a session can hold.
body: Neotoma gives your agents a durable, correctable record of facts, decisions, provenance, and disagreement. They can take on longer-lived work without asking you to re-upload context, repeat a correction, or arbitrate conflicting recollections by hand.
footnote: Robust epistemological design for agents · open source · local-first
